notes: Manufacturer SKU is TLF5300, marketed as "ViA" / "ViA Field Portable Audio Codec" (Tieline: The Codec Company). Portable/desktop field unit (135mm W x 80mm H x 200mm D, ~1.62kg) — not rack mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Connector list drawn from Tieline's own online ViA v2.16 user manual (External Connections page) and cross-checked against Broadcast Supply Worldwide's ViA spec listing (bswusa.com) and B&H search-cached specs, which agree on 3x female XLR mic/line inputs, 2x male XLR outputs, 3x 6.35mm headphone jacks, dual Gigabit Ethernet, 2x USB 2.0 host ports, and 12VDC/3A external power. The current shipping manual (v5.1, PDF at tieline.com) was too large to fetch directly, so panel layout/labels are taken from the v2.16 HTML manual; core I/O counts and types match the current product page and retailer listings, so this is unlikely to have changed, but minor label/firmware differences vs. the very latest hardware revision (or the optional ViA Global dual-SIM LTE variant) cannot be fully ruled out. Omitted non-signal/power items: internal battery bay (proprietary slot, not an external connector), SD card slot (storage, no cable), and the rear expansion module slot (accepts optional ISDN or POTS module — not populated by default). DB15 Control Port has no exact match in the allowed connector list (nearest D-sub family match "rs232" used instead — flagged per-port). AES3/AES42 capability is layered on the Input 1 XLR jack rather than being a separate connector, so no dedicated "aes3" connector id was used.

ports.name: Input 1 (Mic/Line/AES3/AES42)
ports.note: Female XLR; channel 1 also accepts AES3 stereo digital or AES42 mono digital microphone signal on the same jack

ports.name: Output 1
ports.note: Male XLR, balanced analog line output

ports.name: Output 2
ports.note: Male XLR, balanced analog line output

ports.name: USB Audio I/O
ports.note: Micro-USB stereo digital audio in/out; alternate aux path to Stereo Line In / S/PDIF (only one aux input active at a time)

ports.name: USB 1 (Host)
ports.note: For attaching a supported cellular modem or USB keyboard

ports.name: USB 2 (Host)
ports.note: For attaching a supported cellular modem or USB keyboard

ports.name: Control Port
ports.note: Physical connector is a 15-pin D-sub (DB15) carrying 4 relay inputs + 4 opto-isolated logic outputs for machine control. DB15 is not in the provided connector list; RS232 (D-sub family) used as closest approximation — this is NOT literally an RS232 serial port.

ports.name: DC Power In
ports.note: 4-pin male XLR; external 12VDC 3A power supply. Unit also runs on an internal removable RRC2057 Li-ion battery pack (no external connector).
